functions.name: extractInitials
functions.duty: Extracts a 1-to-2 uppercase character monogram from a user name, returning '?' for empty or non-string inputs.

functions.name: generateSvgAvatar
functions.duty: Generates a deterministic, gradient-filled circular SVG avatar containing the user's initials when their TikTok profile photo is missing or blocked.

functions.name: fetchAvatarWithCache
functions.duty: Fetches an avatar from TikTok CDN with a 5-second abort timeout and LRU caching, falling back to a generated SVG avatar on HTTP errors or network timeouts.

functions.name: avatarProxyRouter
functions.duty: Express route handler serving avatar images with permissive CORS headers and a 24-hour cache-control header for browser WebGL textures.

functions.name: parseColorCommand
functions.duty: Parses !color chat commands, strictly resolving to one of 4 canonical Slime colors (green, red, blue, yellow) or Vietnamese aliases, and explicitly rejecting hex codes.

functions.name: sanitizeComment
functions.duty: Masks profane or sensitive words in chat messages by replacing matched characters with asterisks.

functions.name: extractUser
functions.duty: Standardizes raw TikTok user attributes into a normalized identity object containing user ID, username, nickname, and avatar URL.

functions.name: normalizeChat
functions.duty: Transforms raw chat payloads into normalized comment events, automatically extracting and attaching valid !color commands.

functions.name: normalizeGift
functions.duty: Normalizes incoming gift payloads by calculating total coin value and categorizing gifts into one of 4 hierarchical tiers.

functions.name: normalizeLike
functions.duty: Sanitizes like event counts and preserves cumulative total likes across the live session.

functions.name: normalizeSocial
functions.duty: Normalizes social stream interactions such as follows, shares, and member joins.

functions.name: normalizeTikTokEvent
functions.duty: Central dispatcher that converts any incoming raw TikTok event into a unified, timestamped event schema.

functions.name: getRandomViewer
functions.duty: Selects and returns a randomized mock viewer profile from the default mock viewer pool.

functions.name: simulateLikes
functions.duty: Generates and emits a synthetic like event for testing without an active stream.

functions.name: simulateChat
functions.duty: Generates and emits a synthetic chat event with predefined or custom text.

functions.name: simulateGift
functions.params: tier = 1, customGiftName = null, customCoins = null, user = null
functions.duty: Generates and emits a synthetic gift event matching a specified gift tier.

functions.name: startAutoSimulation
functions.duty: Starts an automated periodic timer randomly generating likes, chats, and tiered gifts.

functions.name: stopAutoSimulation
functions.duty: Clears the periodic simulation timer and halts automatic event generation.

functions.name: enqueue
functions.duty: Enqueues incoming live events, immediately bypassing Tier 2-4 VIP gifts and aggregating likes into sliding-window combos.

functions.name: flushCombo
functions.duty: Packages accumulated like combos into a single batched event and pushes it to the dispatch queue.

functions.name: drainQueue
functions.duty: Immediately flushes pending combos and drains all queued events through the dispatch callback.

functions.name: getQueueSize
functions.duty: Returns the current number of pending events held in the rate limiter queue.

functions.name: reset
functions.duty: Clears all pending events, resets the like combo accumulator, and halts running timers.

functions.name: broadcast
functions.duty: Serializes and broadcasts JSON message payloads to all currently connected WebSocket clients.

functions.name: connect
functions.duty: Establishes a real-time scraping connection to a TikTok LIVE room by username with automatic event binding.

functions.name: _bindEvents
functions.duty: Attaches internal event listeners for TikTok chat, gift, like, social, room user counts, and disconnects.

functions.name: _scheduleReconnect
functions.duty: Schedules an automatic reconnection attempt using exponential backoff when a stream drops unexpectedly.

functions.name: disconnect
functions.duty: Manually terminates the active TikTok webcast connection and cancels pending reconnect timers.

functions.name: getStatus
functions.duty: Returns the current live connection status, room ID, viewer count, and connected username.

functions.name: split3BandFrequency
functions.duty: Slices an FFT byte frequency spectrum into isolated Bass (0-150Hz), Mids (150-1000Hz), and Treble (>1000Hz) energy values.

functions.name: calculateAudioFlux
functions.duty: Computes smoothed running average energy and instantaneous positive onset flux for beat detection.

functions.name: synthesizeSfxParams
functions.duty: Provides procedural frequency, gain, and timing parameters for zero-asset sound synthesis.

functions.name: getBeatStepEvents
functions.duty: Maps a 16-step sequencer index to discrete Kick (four-on-the-floor), Snare (backbeat), and Hi-Hat triggers.

functions.name: start
functions.duty: Starts the 16-step 128 BPM loop timer and connects procedural drum voices to the audio destination.

functions.name: _playStep
functions.duty: Synthesizes swept-sine kicks, bandpass filtered snare noise, and highpass hi-hat ticks for the current sequencer step.

functions.name: stop
functions.duty: Halts the procedural drum loop and clears active step timers.

functions.name: setVolume
functions.duty: Adjusts the master gain volume level of the procedural beat engine.

functions.name: unlockAudio
functions.duty: Resumes the browser AudioContext from suspended state upon user interaction and starts the beat synthesizer.

functions.name: getBands
functions.duty: Reads current frequency data from the AnalyserNode and returns normalized energy and flux across 3 audio bands.

functions.name: playSfx
functions.duty: Procedurally synthesizes sound effects (coin clink, air horn, bass boom) with exponential clickless decay envelopes.

functions.name: setVolume
functions.duty: Updates the global sound effects volume gain.

functions.name: toggleMute
functions.duty: Toggles audio master gain between muted and unmuted states.

functions.name: parseColorCommand
functions.duty: Parses chat comments for !color directives, returning a canonical Slime color definition while rejecting hex values.

functions.name: getSlimeKinematics
functions.duty: Calculates volume-preserving mathematical Squash & Stretch scale factors and vertical bounce jump displacement synchronized with music BPM.

functions.name: getDanceKinematics
functions.duty: Computes procedurally animated limb and torso rotation offsets for humanoid and procedural dance styles.

functions.name: touch
functions.duty: Registers or touches a viewer's activity timestamp, accumulates coins, updates VIP tiers, and evicts idle avatars over capacity.

functions.name: disposeAvatar
functions.duty: Safely unmounts an avatar from the 3D scene and disposes of all mesh materials, geometries, and canvas textures to prevent VRAM leaks.

functions.name: createSlimeGeometry
functions.duty: Creates a smooth sphere geometry with a flattened bottom vertex profile to sit naturally on the dance floor.

functions.name: createSlimeFaceTexture
functions.duty: Generates a procedural 2D canvas face texture featuring glossy eyes and a smile without rosy cheeks.

functions.name: createAvatarMesh
functions.duty: Builds a complete 3D Slime mesh hierarchy with translucent jelly material, blinking eyes, VIP accessories, and overhead billboard.

functions.name: setSlimeColor
functions.duty: Updates the material color and emissive glow of an existing 3D Slime to a chosen canonical color.

functions.name: createBillboardSprite
functions.duty: Creates a 3D billboard sprite displaying the user's TikTok avatar, nickname, and VIP rank badge above their Slime.

functions.name: init
functions.duty: Coordinates setup of ambient lights, moving heads, lasers, VIP podium, DJ booth, and particle systems.

functions.name: createAccentLights
functions.duty: Adds overhead spotlights for the DJ console and warm amber point lights for the bar lounge.

functions.name: createLedFloor
functions.duty: Constructs an 8x8 matrix of LED floor tiles in a single draw call using Three.js InstancedMesh.

functions.name: createVipPodium
functions.duty: Builds an elevated circular VIP podium featuring a gold metallic rim and glowing neon glass stage top.

functions.name: createDjBooth
functions.duty: Assembles the DJ table with spinning vinyl records, Pioneer-style mixer, and animated DJ mascot.

functions.name: createWallsAndNeon
functions.duty: Constructs club boundary walls, bar counters, and emissive neon club signage.

functions.name: createMovingHeads
functions.duty: Builds 4 dual-axis moving head spotlights that sweep light cones across the venue.

functions.name: createLaserBeams
functions.duty: Creates 6 additive-blended laser beam geometry cones fanning out from the ceiling rig.

functions.name: createFireworksSystem
functions.duty: Initializes a 6,000-particle single-buffer Points system for multi-tier fireworks bursts.

functions.name: createFlyingHeartsSystem
functions.duty: Initializes a single-buffer particle system for floating 3D hearts triggered by viewer likes.

functions.name: emitFlyingHearts
functions.duty: Spawns floating hearts that rise from the floor and sway upward upon viewer likes.

functions.name: update
functions.duty: Updates vinyl rotation, moving head sweeps, laser strobes, floor tile colors, and particle physics each frame.

functions.name: handleLiveEvent
functions.duty: Processes incoming normalized WebSocket live events, routing likes, chats, gifts, and follows to visual and audio systems.

functions.name: getOrCreateAvatarMesh
functions.duty: Retrieves or instantiates a 3D Slime avatar mesh for a viewer, positioning it on a vacant dance floor grid slot.

functions.name: animate
functions.duty: The main 60 FPS WebGL render loop updating audio analysis, camera transitions, Slime squash-and-stretch, and environmental lighting.

functions.name: getOrbitCameraPosition
functions.duty: Computes clamped spherical orbit coordinates keeping the camera within room boundaries and focused on the dance floor.

functions.name: init
functions.duty: Configures renderer pixel ratio, shadow-free tone mapping, and window resize event listeners.

functions.name: setCameraPreset
functions.duty: Smoothly transitions the camera position, focus target, and FOV to a designated camera preset.

functions.name: toggleChromaKey
functions.duty: Switches the viewport background between standard club atmosphere and chroma key green for OBS streaming.

functions.name: toggleAlpha
functions.duty: Toggles WebGL clear alpha between opaque black and transparent for OBS browser overlays.

functions.name: onResize
functions.duty: Updates camera aspect ratio and renderer dimensions when the browser window or stream canvas resizes.

functions.name: update
functions.duty: Lerps camera position and look-at target smoothly toward the active preset, pulsing orbit distance on bass hits.

functions.name: initElements
functions.duty: Caches DOM element references for fast real-time UI updates during stream events.

functions.name: bindEvents
functions.duty: Binds event listeners for UI interactions, audio unlock banner, keyboard shortcuts, and admin form submissions.

functions.name: unlockAudioHandler
functions.duty: Handles the 1-click audio unlock prompt, resuming AudioContext and fading out the prompt banner.

functions.name: bindMockButton
functions.duty: Attaches click handlers to admin drawer mock simulation buttons.

functions.name: toggleAdminDrawer
functions.duty: Toggles visibility of the streamer administration sidebar drawer.

functions.name: updateTikTokStatus
functions.duty: Updates the HUD connection badge with real-time TikTok room status and viewer count.

functions.name: addHype
functions.duty: Increments stream Hype Meter points and triggers 15-second Frenzy Mode when the meter reaches 100%.

functions.name: triggerFrenzyMode
functions.duty: Activates the 15-second club Frenzy party mode with air horn SFX and full-room fireworks.

functions.name: showGiftAlert
functions.duty: Displays an animated glassmorphic gift alert card with donor avatar, name, and gift tier icon.

functions.name: updateLeaderboard
functions.duty: Updates the Top 3 Donors leaderboard widget with rank badges and accumulated coin totals.
